[[Daman Mills]] ([[JN100]]) |jpva=[[Toru Nara]] }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{fire color light}} |member=[[Sinnoh League]] |rank=[[Elite Four]] }} |} '''Flint''' (Japanese: '''オーバ''' ''Ōba'') is a member of the [[Elite Four]] of the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Fire}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. == History == === Pre-series === [[File:Young Flint.png|left|thumb|250px|A young Flint and his Chimchar]] Flint grew up battling gangs and [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poachers]] on the streets of [[Sunyshore City]]. He eventually came across [[Volkner]] and decided to challenge him to a {{pkmn|battle}} and ultimately emerged victorious. Volkner would challenge Flint sometime later and win, thus igniting an intense rivalry. The two later became friends after battling against the [[Proprietor]] in a Tag Battle. When Flint turned 20, he left Sunyshore to pursue his own journey and eventually became a member of the [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]], while Volkner assumed the role of Sunyshore City's [[Gym Leader]]. However, Flint constantly returned to Sunyshore City to convince the increasingly despondent Volkner to start battling again but to no avail, which also somewhat strained their friendship as Flint became increasingly frustrated with Volkner's lack of passion for battling and overall aloof treatment towards him. === {{aniseries|DP}} === [[File:Ignitionshipping.png|thumb|250px|Flint and Volkner]] Flint was first mentioned in ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]'' by [[Lucian]], and again in ''[[DP099|A Trainer and Child Reunion!]]'' by [[Officer Jenny]]. Flint made his physical debut in ''[[DP165|Flint Sparks the Fire!]]''. He noticed {{Ash}}'s determination as he walked by the Sunyshore Gym, and went on to escort the group directly to[Volkner, who was hiding away in the [[Sunyshore Tower]]. After Volkner declined Ash's challenge to a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, Flint took {{ashfr|the group}} to a café run by his old friend, the Proprietor, and shared his and Volkner's past with the group. After Volkner arrived and once again refused Ash's challenge for a battle, Flint battled Ash in his place and defeated {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{AP|Infernape}}, and {{AP|Buizel}} with his {{TP|Flint|Infernape}} easily. In the process, Volkner observed the match and became reinvigorated upon observing Ash's teamwork with his Pokémon. Flint was glad to see this development and watched as Volkner reconsidered his decision to turn Ash away. [[File:Flint vs Cynthia.png|thumb|left|250px|Flint battling against {{an|Cynthia}}]] In ''[[DP166|The Fleeing Tower of Sunyshore!]]'', Flint sat in the grandstands to watch Volkner go up against Ash. The Gym battle was interrupted by {{TRT}} after they stole the Sunyshore Tower and caused the city to have a power outage. Flint, Volkner, and Ash all jumped onto the tower as Team Rocket was beginning to rocket into the sky, though Flint lost his grip and feel into the ocean below. However, he worked with {{an|Brock}} to provide pedal power to the local [[Pokémon Center]] during the crisis. Flint later watched as Volkner landed the Sunyshore Tower back onto the ground, and he wished {{an|Dawn}} the best with her upcoming {{pkmn|Contest}}s as she and her friends left Sunyshore. In ''[[DP179|The Eighth Wonder of the Sinnoh World!]]'', Flint watched Volkner battle Ash again. In the [[DP180|next episode]], he saved {{si|Kenny}}'s {{p|Floatzel}} from Team Rocket and won against [[Jasmine]] in an {{wp|exhibition game|exhibition match}}. He also revealed that he would be challenging {{an|Cynthia}} for the title of [[Sinnoh League]] {{pkmn|Champion}}. Ash and his friends watched Flint battle Cynthia at the {{DL|Pokémon League|Champion League}} on TV in ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]''. As mentioned by the announcer, Flint's Infernape managed to defeat two of Cynthia's Pokémon. However, Flint lost the match after his Infernape was defeated by [[Cynthia's Garchomp]]. [[File:Flint and Leon.png|thumb|250px|Flint and Leon]] Flint made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. === {{aniseries|JN}} === In ''[[JN100|Meeting Up with the Monarch!]]'', Flint had a [[World Coronation Series]] battle against {{an|Leon}}, where he used Infernape against [[Leon's Charizard]], only to lose, causing his rank to drop from 7 to 8. In ''[[JN109|Aim For The Eight!]]'', Flint was revealed to have fallen out of the Master Class. In ''[[JN117|The Fiery Road to Mastership!]]'', Flint was shown watching Cynthia's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Iris}}. == Character == Flint is a supportive friend, and despite all of his success as a member of the [[Elite Four]], he made several efforts to reach out to [[Volkner]] over the years in hopes of restoring his friend's passion for battling. At the same time, Flint isn't above expressing his frustration with Volkner's newfound aloof and apathetic behavior, even threatning to punch his friend over his attitude. He is also passionate about battling and a prolific user of defense, a strategy he used to defeat {{Ash}} and later [[Jasmine]] of the [[Olivine Gym]]. In addition to strategy, in ''[[DP180|Four Roads Diverged in a Pokémon Port!]]'', Flint told Ash that having confidence in oneself is just as critical to being a successful [[Pokémon Trainer]]. == Pokémon == This listing is of Flint's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {| width="100%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Flint|Infernape|Flint Infernape.png|fire|fighting|size=250px|fir=Chimchar|mid=Monferno}} | |} Flint also has at least five more Pokémon, which he used during his battle against Cynthia. == Achievements == === Badges obtained === [[File:Flint Ranking WCS.png|250px|thumb|Flint's World Coronation Series ranking (prior to ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'')]] This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Flint has obtained in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]'') === Pokémon League === Flint has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] - Winner (prior to ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]'') === World Coronation Series === Flint has competed in the World Coronation Series. His rank and class are as follows: * Rank 7 (Master Class; prior to ''[[JN100|Meeting Up with the Monarch!]]'') * Rank 8 (Master Class; ''[[JN100|Meeting Up with the Monarch!]]'') * Rank unknown (Ultra Class; prior to ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'') == Voice actors == {{vatable|color={{fire color}}|bordercolor={{fire color light}} |de=Patrick Roche |ja=奈良徹 ''[[Toru Nara]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] ([[DP165]]-[[DP180]])
[[Daman Mills]] ([[JN100]]) |cs=Petr Neskusil |fi=Petrus Kähkönen |he=קובי ליקורמן ''Kobi Likverman'' ([[JN100]]) |it=Renato Novara |pl=Grzegorz Kwiecień |pt_br=Márcio Marconatto |es_la=Arturo Castañeda |es_eu=Luis Reina |sv=Jonas Ring |tr=Levent Sülün }} == Trivia == * Flint is the only member of the [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]] to have appeared outside of {{aniseries|DP}}. * While his younger brother [[Buck]] has appeared in ''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl'', his connection to Flint has never been hinted at. == Related articles == {{reflist}} * [[Flint]] {{worldcoronation|fire}} {{Project Anime notice}}
